title: Current and Provision
author: A. M. Underhill
blurb: Xanthe Thackeray, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
